sourceTitle: BIS Statutory Product Certification Application & Marking Fee Schedule
sanitizedContent: Under BIS Product Certification Regulations 2018: Application fee is ₹1,000 for domestic manufacturers. Annual licence fee is ₹1,000. Minimum marking fees vary by product schedule (e.g. ₹45,000 for electrical cables, ₹50,000 for TMT steel). Udyam-registered Micro & Small Enterprises (MSMEs) receive a statutory 50% concession on minimum marking fees.
